Shoplinker product query

API for querying Shoplinker products.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/product_list.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required st_date string Start date
3. Required ed_date string End date
4. partner_product_id string Your own product code (product management code) There is no date restriction when specifying your own code.
5. barcode string Barcode
6. page string Page number Specify the page number when there are more than 500 products
7. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page The default is 500 records.

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<openMarket>
	<productInfo>
		<product>
			<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
			<st_date>20150303</st_date>
			<ed_date>20150303</ed_date>
			<partner_product_id>a586</partner_product_id>
			<page>1</page>
			<total_standard_count>1000</total_standard_count>
		</product>
	</productInfo>
</openMarket>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. partner_product_id_t string Your own product code (product management code) Product code managed in your own system
4. sale_status string Sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Waiting : 002
  3. - Sales suspended : 003
  4. - Sold out : 004
  5. - Delete : 005
  6. - Sales ended : 006
5. category_l string Shoplinker level 1 category code If your own category exists, send your own category
6. category_m string Shoplinker level 2 category code Example: cat00200
7. category_s string Shoplinker level 3 category code Example: cat00201
8. category_d string Shoplinker level 4 category code Example: cat00202
9. ccategory_l string Your own level 1 category code Example: A01
10. ccategory_m string Your own level 2 category code Example: B01
11. ccategory_s string Your own level 3 category code Example: C01
12. ccategory_d string Your own level 4 category code Example: D01
13. maker string Manufacturer
14. maker_dt string Publication date (manufacturing date) yyyymmdd
15. register_date string Product registration date yyyymmdd
16. origin string Country of origin name
17. market_price integer Marketplace list price (book list price) If absent, register the same value as the marketplace sale price
18. sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
19. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price If absent, register the same value as the marketplace sale price
20. market_price_p integer Supplier market price If absent, register the same value as the marketplace sale price
21. sale_price_p integer Supplier selling price If absent, register the same value as the marketplace sale price
22. supply_price_p integer Supplier supply price If absent, register the same value as the marketplace sale price
23. delivery_charge_type string Shipping fee type Allowed values
  • - Free shipping : 001
  • - Freight collect : 002
  • - Collect freight paid in advance : 003
  • - Free shipping for orders of KRW 30,000 or more : 004
  • - Free shipping for orders of KRW 50,000 or more : 005
  • - Free shipping for orders of KRW 70,000 or more : 006
  • - Free shipping for orders of KRW 100,000 or more : 007
24. delivery_charge integer Collect-on-delivery shipping amount
25. tax_yn string Taxable Allowed values
  1. - Taxable : 001
  2. - Tax-exempt : 002
26. detail_desc string Detailed description
27. new_desc_top string New detailed description Optional value for ESM products
28. new_desc_center string Additional component detailed description Optional value for ESM products
29. new_desc_bottom string Advertising/promotional details Optional value for ESM products
30. desc_type_tag string Quality labeling TAG and detailed description Applies only to Hyundai Home Shopping
31. quantity integer Available supply quantity If no value is supplied, register 900 units
32. salearea string Sales region If no value is supplied, register as 001 (nationwide)
33. partner_id string Supplier ID The supplier ID can only be set when adding a product and cannot be updated.
Changing the supplier ID may create duplicate products. Use caution.
34. sex string Product gender Allowed values
  1. - Unisex : 001
  2. - Men's : 002
  3. - Women's : 003
35. keyword string Product keywords (short product name)
36. model string Model name
37. model_no string Model NO When using isbn (book code), the value must start with "isbn-".
38. brand string Brand name
39. auth_no string Certification number
40. expirydate string Valid date yyyymmdd
41. option_info string Option information CombinationOptionName||CombinationOption1^^Quantity<**>Price,CombinationOption2^^Quantity<**>Price~~
The characters '(', ')', '/', '^', and ',' are Shoplinker delimiters and must not appear in option content.
42. product_name string Product name
43. image_url string Image address information
44. image_seq string Image seq Image type No
45. item_group_no string Product disclosure group seq
46. item_group_title string Product disclosure group title
47. gosi_name string Individual product disclosure title
48. gosi_seq string Individual product disclosure seq
49. gosi_value string Individual product disclosure content
50. barcode string Barcode
51. count_all string Total product count Located in MessageHeader
52. total_page string Total pages Located in MessageHeader
53. currently_page string Current page Located in MessageHeader
54. currently_count string Number of products displayed on the current page Located in MessageHeader
55. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page Located in MessageHeader
